suggestions.title: Increase Instagram posting frequency and content strategy
suggestions.problem: Instagram reach is 0 today, indicating no recent posts or visibility issues. This suggests inconsistent or missing content strategy.
suggestions.root_cause: Possible causes: no posts published today, posting during low-engagement hours, or insufficient hashtag/caption optimization. Instagram algorithm favors consistent posting.
suggestions.suggestion: Establish a daily Instagram posting schedule (1-2 posts per day) featuring bakery discoveries with high-quality images, local reviews, and location tags. Use 15-20 relevant hashtags including #ちるまる #カフェ #パン屋さん #カフェ巡り and location-based tags.
suggestions.expected_impact: Daily reach should increase from 0 to 100-500+ impressions per post within 2 weeks. This drives awareness and website traffic.
suggestions.implementation_note: Create a content calendar template: Monday=Bakery spotlight, Wednesday=User-generated content, Friday=New discovery. Example caption: 'みつけた!新宿の隠れ家パン屋🍞 ちるまるで詳しく見る👇 [link]' with call-to-action to website.

suggestions.title: Reduce bounce rate by improving landing page relevance
suggestions.problem: Website has 32 total sessions over 7 days but only 11 engaged sessions (34% engagement rate). High bounce rate indicates visitors aren't finding what they need.
suggestions.root_cause: Instagram traffic (or other sources) may be directing users to generic homepage rather than specific bakery pages. Misalignment between ad/post promise and landing page content causes immediate exits.
suggestions.suggestion: Create bakery-specific landing pages with direct links from Instagram posts. Each Instagram post should link to a dedicated page featuring that specific bakery with photos, reviews, hours, location map, and user ratings.
suggestions.expected_impact: Increase engaged sessions from 34% to 60%+. If Instagram drives 50 sessions/week with 60% engagement, that's 30 engaged sessions vs current 5-6.
suggestions.implementation_note: Update Instagram bio link to use UTM parameters: 'https://chirumaru.com/bakery/[bakery-id]?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=bio' instead of homepage. Example post: '#新宿パン屋 ↓プロフィールのリンクから詳細確認' [bakery-specific image]

suggestions.title: Implement engagement triggers and content optimization
suggestions.problem: Multiple days show sessions but zero engaged sessions (Aug 17, 11, 18). Users visiting but not interacting suggests poor content discoverability or unclear call-to-action.
suggestions.root_cause: Website may lack clear navigation, search functionality, or compelling reasons to explore. Users don't know what to do after landing.
suggestions.suggestion: Add prominent calls-to-action above the fold: 'どのカフェを探す?' with category filters (新しいカフェ、近くのカフェ、ランキング). Implement quick-view bakery cards with ratings, one-click save/favorite feature, and 'もっと見る' buttons.
suggestions.expected_impact: Convert 50% of non-engaged sessions to engaged sessions. With current 7-8 sessions/day average, increase daily engaged sessions from 0.7 to 3-4 sessions.
suggestions.implementation_note:
Add homepage banner: `
